nodes.title: The Question Paper will have 75 questions.

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: All questions will be based on Subject-Specific Knowledge.
UNIT – I
nodes.body: Sociology: Definition, nature and scope; Relationship with other Social Sciences: Psychology, Anthropology, History, Economics and Political Science.

nodes.title: UNIT – II
nodes.body: Basic Concepts: Social Structure, Society, Social Organization, Community, Association,Norms, Values.

nodes.title: UNIT – III
nodes.body: Status and Role: Types of status and role and their interrelationship

nodes.title: UNIT – IV
nodes.body: Socialization: Meaning, types, processes and agencies. Theories of self (Freud, Cooley and Mead) Culture: Meaning, characteristics; material and non-material culture; cultural lag. Culture and civilization.

nodes.title: UNIT – I
nodes.body: Social Processes: Cooperation, Accommodation, Assimilation, Competition and Conflict.

nodes.title: UNIT – II
nodes.body: Social Groups: Definition, characteristics, types (primary and secondary; in-group and out- group; Reference group and Peer group).

nodes.title: UNIT – III
nodes.body: Social Institutions: Marriage; Family; Kinship

nodes.title: Education, Religion and Economy: Meaning and Functions
UNIT – IV
nodes.body: Social Control: Meaning, Significance and agencies. Social Deviance: Meaning, characteristics, forms and factors.

nodes.title: UNIT – I
nodes.body: Societies: Types and Characteristics- Tribal, Rural, Urban, Industrial and Post-Industrial.

nodes.title: UNIT – II
nodes.body: Culture: Definition and Nature; Types- Material and Non- Material.Socialization: Importance, Process and Stages.

nodes.title: UNIT – III
nodes.body: Processes of Social Change: Characteristic Features of Industrialization, Modernization,Globalization and Secularization.

nodes.title: UNIT – IV
nodes.body: Social Stratification: Types, theories of stratificationsocial mobility and its types.

nodes.title: UNIT – I
nodes.body: Evolution of Indian Society: Traditional basis of Indian Society; Unity and Diversity in India; India as a Pluralistic Society.

nodes.title: UNIT – II
nodes.body: Caste, theories of Caste system and its Changing Dimensions in India; Dominant caste.

nodes.title: UNIT – III
nodes.body: Processes of Social Change in India: Sanskritization, Westernization, Modernization,Prophetization and Universalization.

nodes.title: UNIT – IV
nodes.body: Social Issues and Problems: Gender Discrimination, Problems of Women; Problems of Dalits, OBCs and Minorities; Affirmative Actions.

nodes.title: UNIT – I
nodes.body: Social Research: Definition, Nature and Purpose; Steps in Social Research; Problem of Objectivity and Subjectivity in Social Research.

nodes.title: UNIT – II
nodes.body: Research Methods: Research Designs; Social Survey; Hypothesis- Types & significance; Sampling and Sampling Procedure.

nodes.title: UNIT – III
nodes.body: Techniques of Data Collection: Observation, Interview, Questionnaire, Schedule and CaseStudy; Types of Data.

nodes.title: UNIT – IV
nodes.body: Statistical Analysis and Use of Computer in Social Research: Classification and Tabulation of data; Measures of Central Tendency: Mean, Median and Mode; Use of Computers in Social Research.

nodes.title: UNIT – I
nodes.body: Social Problem: Meaning and Definition; Importance of the Study of Social Problems; Sociological Perspectives on Social Problem-Anomie and suicide (Durkheim) Labeling (Becker).

nodes.title: UNIT – II
nodes.body: Structural Issues: Inequality of Caste, Class, Gender and Ethnicity.

nodes.title: UNIT – III
nodes.body: Problems and Issues: Female Feticide, Dowry, Domestic Violence, Divorce; Problems of Aged.

nodes.title: UNIT – IV
nodes.body: Social Disorganization: Crime, Juvenile Delinquency, Corruption, Communalism, Drug Addiction, Suicide, Nepotism, Prostitution and AIDS.
